description.text: Starter Set Tera Type: Stellar Sylveon ex, released on 30 August 2024 with Ceruledge ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck around a new Sylveon ex with the Stellar Tera type, whose Magical Charm does 160 damage and weakens the Defending Pokémon's attacks by 100 for a turn, and whose Angelite shuffles two of the opponent's Benched Pokémon into their deck. Eevee's Boost Evolution lets it evolve on its first turn, and Tera Orb finds a Tera Pokémon. The deck introduced a new ACE SPEC, Precious Trolley, which puts any number of Basic Pokémon from the deck onto the Bench. The box held damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a coin, a playmat and a guide.
